candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Text of body and all questions is accurate, including correct 訊く and 紛れもない and proper 『ノー』 quote styles. Furigana mostly captured but the き furigana on 聴く is missing. Omits the marginal line number 27 and the entire sidebar (ユニット / 4 / ことばと文化). No invented content.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Multiple misreadings: 訊く→訳く (twice), 『喋るアメリカ人』→『嫌されアメリカ人』, 紛れもない→却れもない (twice), 言い回しでも→言い回しても. Drops all furigana from the citation, and invents furigana 意図(いと) not present in the image. Does capture the marginal line number 27, but omits the sidebar. Also flattens 『』 quotes to 「」.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Most complete and accurate: correct 訊く, 紛れもない, quote styles, all furigana captured (including 聴（き）く), and the sidebar text ユニット / 4 / ことばと文化 transcribed. Only omission is the marginal line number 27. Headings rendered with ■ approximating the black bar marker.

rationale: C is the most faithful transcription: it gets all difficult kanji right (訊く, 紛れもない, 喋る), preserves furigana including 聴（き）, and is the only candidate to transcribe the vertical sidebar (ユニット 4 ことばと文化); its only miss is the marginal line number 27. A is nearly as accurate in the body text but omits the 聴く furigana, the marginal 27, and the sidebar. B ranks last due to numerous character errors (訊く→訳く twice, 紛れもない→却れもない twice, garbled book title 『嫌されアメリカ人』), dropped citation furigana, flattened quote marks, and a hallucinated furigana reading 意図(いと), though it uniquely captured the marginal 27.
